title: Luxury Home Renovation in Scarsdale, NY: What You Need to Know
excerpt: Scarsdale homeowners deserve renovation work that respects their properties' character while adding real value. We'll walk you through what makes a renovation successful in this particular community.
content:
Why Scarsdale Homeowners Choose Design-Build

Scarsdale has some of Westchester County's most distinctive homes. Many were built in the early 1900s. Others are mid-century colonials sitting on beautiful properties. When you own a home like that, renovation work matters. You're not just updating a house. You're protecting something real.

That's why we work as a design-build firm. Silvio M. Luca is both a licensed architect in New York and a licensed general contractor in Westchester. He runs every project himself. That means the person designing your renovation is the same person managing the build. There's no handoff between architects and contractors. No miscommunication. No surprises halfway through.

What Luxury Renovation Looks Like in Scarsdale

In Scarsdale, luxury home renovation usually means opening up kitchens that were designed for a different era. It means adding primary suites with real bathrooms. It means second-story additions that actually fit the footprint of your original house. It means respecting what made your home worth buying in the first place.

We handle kitchen remodels. We do bathroom renovations. We add onto homes that need more space without tearing them down. We handle historic restorations when an older Scarsdale home needs careful work. Open-concept conversions are common too, especially when a family wants to flow living spaces together.

Sometimes the right move is a full addition. A new primary suite. A second story that feels like it was always part of the house. Whatever the project, our residential architect in Scarsdale takes time to understand what you're actually trying to accomplish.

The Permit Process Works the Same for Every Town

Every municipality in Westchester has its own building department and permit process. Scarsdale is no different. That's just how it works in the county. We handle permits for Scarsdale, Bronxville, Larchmont, and everywhere else we work. It's part of the job. We know the officials. We know the timelines. We prepare documents the way your specific building department wants them.

Design-Build Saves Time and Headaches

When you hire a residential architect separate from a general contractor in Westchester, you're managing two different companies with two different priorities. As a design-build firm, we eliminate that problem. The design works because the person building it designed it. Home additions in Westchester look better and cost less when one person owns the whole process.

Scarsdale homeowners are thoughtful about their properties. They want renovation work done right. They want someone who understands their town, their homes, and what permits require. That's what we do.
